title: Heartburn – By Nora Ephron
description:
This week’s Novels & Nibbles is all about affairs of the heart with a little “pasta on the side”. Rachel Samstat, a sharp, very pregnant food writer, discovers her charming husband, Mark, is cheating on her… again. What follows is a deliciously bitter-sweet unraveling of marriage, ego, and identity, told with cutting wit and a side of recipes.

Meet Linguine alla Cecca, a dish that doesn’t believe in cooking, just like some people don’t believe in honesty, Mark! 

Juicy tomatoes, bright basil, and a kiss of garlic glossed in olive oil, twirled through warm linguine because sometimes the simplest things are the ones you trust the most.

A little romance, a little regret, and a lot of really good pasta. Your table’s waiting. SO GOOD!
